items.quote: ...for all the 17-year-olds choosing their future careers, it might be wise to sit down with AI and explore what jobs could soon be history.

items.quote: Imagine pouring years into a career only to find out that AI’s taken over your role. Not ideal. So, here’s my question: which professions do you think will still be relevant 20 years from now? Comment Below 👇
